findings.title: Seed effect re-runs on project prop change, wiping edits
findings.problem: The chargeback seed effect's dependency array is [visible, project], so it re-seeds not only on open but on every change of the project prop identity, resetting chargeback, linkedCostCenter (including an inline-created center) and chargebackError.
findings.impact: A parent re-render passing a new project object while the modal is open silently discards in-progress chargeback edits and an inline-created/linked cost center. Reachability depends on the parent passing a new project identity while the modal stays visible, which was not confirmed in the diff.
findings.recommendation: Key the seed on the open transition only (e.g. track previous visible) instead of the project reference, or guard the re-seed so it does not run while the modal is already open with unsaved edits.

findings.title: Cost-center attribution can be saved with no linked center
findings.problem: onFormSubmit computes costCenterId = attribution==='cost_center' ? linkedCostCenter?.id : undefined and PATCHes with no validation; enabling chargeback, choosing 'Cost center' and never creating/linking one submits chargeback_attribution:'cost_center' with cost_center_id: undefined. The submit button is never disabled for this state.
findings.impact: An inconsistent chargeback configuration (cost_center attribution with no cost center) is persisted to the project. Whether the backend rejects or stores it is unverified.
findings.recommendation: Block submit (or show a validation error) when chargeback_enabled && attribution==='cost_center' && !linkedCostCenter?.id, requiring a linked or created cost center before save.

findings.title: Switching attribution away leaves a stale cost-center link
findings.problem: When the user switches attribution from 'cost_center' back to 'project', costCenterId resolves to undefined and clear_cost_center is never set; projectsStore maps cost_center_id: data.clear_cost_center ? undefined : data.cost_center_id, so the PATCH carries cost_center_id: undefined with no clear flag.
findings.impact: A previously linked cost center is likely left in place on the backend after the user visibly deselected cost_center attribution, leaving a stale link. The exact backend PATCH semantics for an undefined cost_center_id were not observable in the diff.
findings.recommendation: Send clear_cost_center: true (or an explicit null) when attribution is 'project' and a cost center was previously linked, so the deselection is persisted.

findings.title: Chargeback prop wiring is untested end to end
findings.problem: project and canManageBudgets are threaded ProjectDetailsPage -> ProjectBudgetsSection -> UnifiedProjectBudgetModal to seed and persist chargeback, but no test exercises the threading: the modal tests pass props directly, ProjectDetailsPage.test asserts nothing about the budget section props (its mockProject omits chargeback fields), and ProjectBudgetsSection has no test file.
findings.impact: A future dropped or mis-wired prop (project=null seeds disabled and overwrites saved settings; canManageBudgets=false skips the chargeback block) would not be caught by any test. The wiring in this diff is correct; the gap is coverage of changed behavior (AC9).
findings.recommendation: Add a test rendering ProjectDetailsPage or ProjectBudgetsSection with a project carrying chargeback_enabled/attribution/cost_center_id and asserting the modal seeds those values and updateProject is called with them.
